public_gates: M1203 may change evaluation/runtime plumbing only
M1203 must not run candidate replay
M1203 must not use private holdout

M1203 must not claim profile superiority or self-identification
forbidden_shortcuts: do not alter reward or env distribution
do not add hidden or oracle actor inputs

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_profile_control_repair_implementation: reset semantics and current-tiled L2 runtime support
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: implements the diagnostic controls required for an interpretable corrected pilot
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: infrastructure only; no training promotion private-holdout paper-level generalization recurrent-belief or self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if reset_hidden_policy cannot be applied without changing actor inputs
stop if current-tiled L2 changes observation dimension or non-history fields
stop if focused tests cannot prove L0/L1/L2/L3 profile semantics
stop if implementation would require private holdout
fallback_plan: route to a narrower evaluator-only repair if current-tiled runtime is too broad
route to profile config generation repair if metadata is insufficient
route to design revision if reset semantics conflict with existing ActorPolicy abstractions
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1202 admits implementation of diagnostic-control repairs

admission_evidence: M1202 specifies current-tiled L2 capacity controls
M1201 identified a concrete L3 reset diagnostic metric artifact
blocked_shortcuts: do not make performance or self-ID claims
allowed_updates: generated current-tiled smoke configs if needed
status, queue, scoreboard, research log, review, and next manifest
next_stage_criteria: reset_hidden_policy is enforced in public eval path
current-tiled L2 transform exists with tests

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1203 implements controls needed to test current-frame substitution but does not itself provide self-ID evidence.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: Implementation only; later corrected pilot may evaluate temporal evidence.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If implementation shows the controls cannot be represented cleanly, route back to design rather than weakening self-ID standards.
allowed_claims: no recurrent-belief, strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: Reset-hidden evaluation semantics and current-tiled L2 runtime controls can be implemented without changing actor inputs or running training.
success_criteria: reset_hidden_policy public eval support is implemented or a focused blocker is recorded
current-tiled L2 runtime support is implemented or a focused blocker is recorded
focused tests cover reset and current-tiled semantics
no training, PPO, candidate replay, promotion, private holdout, per-profile tuning, or actor-input contract expansion occurs
next smoke or repair milestone is selected
failure_criteria: hidden or oracle actor inputs are introduced
focused tests do not cover the corrected semantics
